```{r}
r_b_gamache <- read_csv("/home/raphael/R/SABER/inst/extdata/r_b_gamache_obs.csv")

spectra_df <- r_b_gamache %>%
  filter(
    wavelength > 400, wavelength < 720,
    class %in% c("algae_coralline", "algae_brown", "sediment")
    ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = wavelength,
    values_from = r_b,
    names_prefix = "wl_"
  )
```

```{r}
clamp01 <- function(x, eps = 1e-6) {
  pmin(pmax(x, eps), 1 - eps)
}

eta_X <- spectra_df %>%
  select(starts_with("wl_")) %>%
  as.matrix()

eta_X <- qlogis(clamp01(eta_X))

eta_long <- eta_X %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(id = row_number()) %>%
  pivot_longer(-id, names_to = "wl", values_to = "eta")

eta_long$wavelength <- as.numeric(gsub("wl_", "", eta_long$wl))

ggplot(eta_long, aes(x = wavelength, y = eta, group = id)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.2) +
  labs(title = "Spectra in eta (logit) space")
```

```{r}
mu_global <- colMeans(eta_X)
Xc <- sweep(eta_X, 2, mu_global, "-")

p <- prcomp(Xc, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)

# Variance explained
explained_var <- p$sdev^2 / sum(p$sdev^2)

plot(explained_var, type = "b",
     main = "Variance explained by each PC",
     ylab = "Proportion of variance")
```

```{r}
q_eff <- 7
eta_U <- p$rotation[, 1:q_eff]

U_df <- as.data.frame(eta_U) %>%
  mutate(wavelength = as.numeric(gsub("wl_", "", colnames(eta_X)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(-wavelength, names_to = "PC", values_to = "value")

ggplot(U_df, aes(x = wavelength, y = value)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~PC, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "PCA basis spectra (eta space)")
```

```{r}
# Position of spectrum in PC space
Ak <- Xc %*% eta_U   # Matrix multiplication: sum of product of Xc rows element to eta_U columns elements

scores_df <- as.data.frame(Ak)
colnames(scores_df) <- paste0("PC", 1:q_eff)

pairs(scores_df[,1:7],
      main = "PCA score space")
```

```{r}
scores_df$class <- spectra_df$class

ggplot(scores_df, aes(PC1, PC2, color = class)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5)
```

```{r}
class_k <- unique(scores_df$class)[1]
Ak_k <- scores_df %>%
  filter(class == class_k) %>%
  select(starts_with("PC")) %>%
  as.matrix()

Sk <- cov(Ak_k)
print(Sk)
```

```{r}
corrplot::corrplot(cor(Ak_k), method = "color")
```

```{r}
i <- 10
r_original <- Xc[i, ]
a <- Ak[i, ]

r_recon <- eta_U %*% a
r_recon <- as.numeric(r_recon)

df_compare <- tibble(
  wavelength = as.numeric(gsub("wl_", "", colnames(eta_X))),
  original = r_original,
  recon = r_recon
)

ggplot(df_compare, aes(wavelength)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = original), color = "black") +
  geom_line(aes(y = recon), color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Original vs PCA reconstruction (eta space)")
```

```{r}
X <- eta_X
mu <- colMeans(X)
Xc <- sweep(X, 2, mu, "-")
p <- prcomp(Xc, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)

max_q <- 20
errs <- numeric(max_q)

for (q in 1:max_q) {
  U <- p$rotation[, 1:q, drop = FALSE]
  A <- Xc %*% U
  Xhat <- A %*% t(U)
  E <- Xc - Xhat
  errs[q] <- mean(E^2)
}

# tibble(q = 1:max_q, mse = errs) %>%
#   ggplot(aes(q, mse)) +
#   geom_line() + geom_point() +
#   geom_text(aes(label = signif(mse, 2)), vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
#   scale_y_log10() +
#   labs(title = "Mean squared reconstruction error vs number of PCs",
#        y = "MSE in eta space")

ply <- tibble(q = 1:max_q, mse = errs) %>%
  plot_ly(
    x = ~q,
    y = ~mse,
    # text = ~sprintf("%.2e", mse),
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "lines+markers+text",
    textposition = "top right",
    marker = list(color = "black"),
    line = list(color = "black")
  ) %>%
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = TeX("\\Large{q}")),
    yaxis = list(
      title = TeX("\\Large{\\text{MSE}}"),
      type = "log"
    ),
    font = font,
    shapes = list(
      border
    )
  ) %>%
  config(mathjax = "cdn", displayModeBar = FALSE)

ply

# save_image(ply, here("4_chapter/figure/pca_q_mse.png"), width = 550, height = 550, scale = 4)
```

```{r}
X <- eta_X
mu <- colMeans(X)
Xc <- sweep(X, 2, mu, "-")
p <- prcomp(Xc, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)

max_q <- 20
errs <- numeric(max_q)

for (q in 1:max_q) {
  U <- p$rotation[, 1:q, drop = FALSE]
  A <- Xc %*% U
  Xhat <- A %*% t(U)
  E <- Xc - Xhat
  if (q == 1) {
    errs[q] <- abs(0 - mean(E^2))
  } else {
    errs[q] <- abs(errs[q-1] - mean(E^2))
  }
  
}

# tibble(q = 1:max_q, mse = errs) %>%
#   ggplot(aes(q, mse)) +
#   geom_line() + geom_point() +
#   geom_text(aes(label = signif(mse, 2)), vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
#   scale_y_log10() +
#   labs(title = "Mean squared reconstruction error vs number of PCs",
#        y = "MSE in eta space")

ply <- tibble(q = 1:max_q, mse = errs) %>%
  plot_ly(
    x = ~q,
    y = ~mse,
    # text = ~sprintf("%.2e", mse),
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "lines+markers+text",
    textposition = "top right",
    marker = list(color = "black"),
    line = list(color = "black")
  ) %>%
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = TeX("\\Large{q}")),
    yaxis = list(
      title = TeX("\\Large{\\text{MSE}}")#,
      # type = "log"
    ),
    font = font,
    shapes = list(
      border
    )
  ) %>%
  config(mathjax = "cdn", displayModeBar = FALSE)

ply
```
